technical.summary: Bullish structure with strong trend confirmation and price action (three white soldiers), but momentum oscillators lack conviction and volume is subpar, limiting swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: JBL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 33 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; broad market fear (40 Fear/Greed score) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and mixed sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.2) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 33 days adds event risk; environment highly unfavourable for equity trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with three white soldiers pattern and supertrend bullish signal suggests structural uptrend initiation in a fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), momentum oscillators lack conviction, volume is subpar, fundamentals show zero smart money alignment, and earnings event risk in 33 days creates uncompensated downside exposure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows bullish price action (three white soldiers, supertrend) above 200-EMA, but this is insufficient to overcome severe macro headwinds and zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis levels create recession environment; earnings in 33 days add uncompensated event risk with no smart money accumulation to support upside.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias
